svg.title: Public GitHub contribution activity heatmap
svg.desc: Public contribution calendar shown on the GitHub profile of frudotz, 23 November 2025 to 22 November 2026 (365 days, snapshot taken 22 November 2026). 1,443 contributions in total; at least one contribution on 78 days. Each square is a day and each column a week starting on Sunday; darker squares mean more contributions that day (5 levels, Less to More). Not a measure of skill or quality.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
